description: This source file defines the internal sealed class 'StreamConsumerCollection' which manages a collection of stream consumers, their activity state, and associated data, with methods for adding, removing, retrieving, and cleaning up consumers within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: StreamConsumerCollection
classes.description: Manages a collection of stream consumers, their activity times, and associated data.

methods.name: AddConsumer
methods.description: Adds a new consumer to the collection with specified subscription ID, stream ID, consumer extension, and filter data.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Removes a consumer given its subscription ID and disposes its cursor if present.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks whether a consumer with the given subscription ID exists in the collection.

methods.name: TryGetConsumer
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve consumer data by subscription ID.

methods.name: AllConsumers
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of all consumer data objects in the collection.

methods.name: DisposeAll
methods.description: Disposes all consumer cursors and clears the collection.

methods.name: RefreshActivity
methods.description: Updates the last activity timestamp to the given time.

methods.name: IsInactive
methods.description: Determines if the stream has been inactive based on last activity time and consumer states.
